[EN] You have the strength of a kitten if you can't carry that! And the sense of a pigling if you think I can help you.
[ES] ¡Tienes la fuerza de un gatito si no puedes cargar con eso! Y el criterio de un pigling si crees que puedo ayudarte.

[EN] Those bags look heavy. Need a hand?
[ES] Esas bolsas se ven pesadas. ¿Necesitas ayuda?

[EN] The federation knows there's power in what we possess, that's why they're keeping something from us. Something powerful!
